bio.text: Wayne Rosenthal is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 108th District, serving from January 2011 to January 2015 and again since January 2023, according to the Illinois General Assembly.
Between his House stints, the legislature biography says Rosenthal was Director of the Illinois Department of Natural Resources from 2015 to 2019.

The biography describes a family farmer and retired brigadier general in the Illinois Air National Guard and U.S. Air Force, a trustee and past president of the Lincoln Land Community College board, and holder of a B.A. in mathematics from Sangamon State University.
